headline: Matternet Appoints Starbucks EVP Sanjay Shah to Board of Directors
summary: MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., July 30, 2026--Matternet, the world's only FAA Type-Certified drone delivery platform, today announced the appointment of Sanjay Shah to its Board of Directors. Mr. Shah currently serves as Executive Vice President and Chief Supply Chain Officer at Starbucks and has held senior operations and supply-chain leadership positions at Gopuff, Beyond Meat, Tesla, Amazon, and Dell.
